lint-ignore.message: Inline lint/type ignores are banned. Fix the code so the rule passes. If the rule is wrong, change the rule in its config and say so in the PR.

timers.message: Timers patch over ordering bugs. Derive state from the event that signals readiness, or await the promise that resolves when it is ready.

console-log.message: console.log must not ship. Remove it, or use the logger.

inner-html.message: Building DOM from strings is how stored XSS happens. Use textContent, framework text bindings, or a vetted sanitizer behind one helper.

broad-except.message: Catch the specific exception you can handle. Let the rest propagate to the boundary that maps errors to responses.

skip-without-issue.message: Skipped tests rot. Fix the test, delete it, or skip with a reason that links an issue (e.g. reason="#123").

comments.message: Comments are banned. Make the code say it: rename, extract a well-named function, or add a type. Durable facts go in CLAUDE.md under 'Facts code can't show'. Only `Critical: <why>` is allowed, for an invariant the code cannot express whose violation causes a bug, security hole, or data loss.
